finding.statement: For any allowed geometric fibre (C_0,gamma_0) and any separated finite-type C-scheme B, the constant clause-(E) family over B has U = B x U_0 with U_0 a smooth connected affine surface open in P^2, and compact-support Kunneth places Gr^W_m H_c^m(B)(-2) as a direct MHS summand of Gr^W_{m+4} H_c^{m+4}(U) for every m, via H_c^4(U_0)=Q(-2). Consequently any theorem asserting Tate type of Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z) uniformly over all allowed bases forces Gr^W_12 H_c^{12}(B) to be Tate for every allowed B, which is false (B=C^8 for the affine Kummer curve of FND-0170 gives a nonzero type-(8,4) component, hence a type-(10,6) class after tensoring with Q(-2)). A repaired C66-TATE-SUPPORT must fix a named base/atlas or impose (H-S)-type corner hypotheses including j=6; universal quantification over reduced locally Noetherian bases is refuted by ATT-0119.
